data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports that the calendar year profit was largely driven by reserve releases on 2012 and earlier years. The report describes these as reserve releases (favourable claims development). No gross prior-year movement amount is clearly extractable from the published tables in the provided images; detailed technical notes appear present but the gross PY movement figure could not be unambiguously read.

data.data_quality_notes: Source images are low-resolution and rotated. Balance sheet and technical provisions tables are present but some numeric cells are difficult to read. Opening gross claims outstanding was read from the Liabilities (Claims outstanding) prior-year column but is not crystal-clear (confidence 0.5). The report text explicitly mentions 'reserve releases from 2012 and prior years' (so direction = release) but no unambiguous GROSS prior-year movement amount could be located in the readable images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross premium is taken from the gross written premium line (42,243) -> 42.243m. No clear claims development triangle was readable; none is provided here.
